'''Charles Lund''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 43, from Coral Gables, FL. After Decipher's SWCCG run, the slot was marked Retired.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Inducted in December 1996, he was a Flight Leader and co-created Rebel Gamers of Miami (later Rebel Gamers of South Florida).<ref name="decsq-prof" />
